svg.title: Motion grammar regression: four motor phases and solved foot trajectories
svg.desc: Planar constraint kinematics, not a LEGO build or walking qualification. Dashed grey lines are grounded bodies; blue curves are foot paths.

g.text: One motor input / generic rigid-body and hinge constraints
Blue: complete foot path. Dots: attachment sites. Grey dashed: ground. Dimensions: LDU (+Y down).

Bodies: chassis / dyad-0-a / dyad-0-b / leg-0-0-coupler / leg-0-0-rocker / leg-0-1-coupler / leg-0-1-rocker / leg-1-0-coupler / leg-1-0-rocker / leg-1-1-coupler / leg-1-1-rocker / shaft-0 / shaft-1 / shaft-2 / shaft-3 / shaft-4 / shaft-5 / shaft-6
